transcript.text: We are blazing through everything that you need to know about Runescape Dragon Wilds, including how to snag a hidden
level two sword within minutes of spawning, why you must sleep through your crafting cues, and the secret to
multiplying your early farming XP by 10. You can track enemy weaknesses at any time via the world tab in your journal.
As an example, let's look up what the Abyssal Demon is weak to. Its weakness is slash, and it's resistant to air.
This means that if you want to use melee to kill the Abyssal Demon, you should consider using a weapon like a
one-handed sword or a two-handed greatsword. Both of those options are slash weapons. Since the Abyssal Demon
is resistant to air, if we are using a weapon enchantment, we should use fiery weapon knowing that it will do its full
damage. And if you want to use magic, do not use air spells on the specific enemy. These small details add up in
difficult fights. You can get a level two sword in the starting zone within minutes of your playthrough. There is a
hidden one-handed sword at the starting church. You will learn the spell windstep within the first hour of your
playthrough. Once learned, go to the starting church in Templewood. Jump on this gravestone, then cast windstep.
Jump at an angle towards the church. Doing this allows you to get to a ledge with a hidden chest. This chest contains
the recipe for the wooden sword. It's a level two weapon that is easy to make and can carry you through your first few
regions in the game. Place load stones at anime events, especially law rune anime events. As you progress through
the game, you'll begin to cross the threshold where the loot from creatures and quests does not give you enough law
runes to continue teleporting and using spells like the surge spell during combat. To counteract this, build load
stones at every law rune anom event that you find. Every few endgame days, the anoms will refresh. Just spend a minute
or two teleporting to each L rune [music] vent, collecting your runes and XP, and then go on with your journey. As
soon as you can, farm cooked cabbage, potatoes, and berries to make the sweet veg ball food. Eating this gives you a
300 second buff that grants 10% more experience in every single skill. Since the ingredients for the sweet veg ball
are so easy to farm, you should keep this buff up constantly in the early game. The sweet veg ball also heals you
for 70 health and 65 substance, making it an S tier food as you progress through the early and mid game. Building
load stones allows players to fast travel. And the cost to teleport using a load stone will vary based on the
distance to target load stone and your character's total weight. If you hover over the load stone that you're
traveling to, you can see the lowering cost before you confirm the fast travel. To power level fishing early, find a
river and use a net on all of the net fishing spots. Catching fish with a net is much faster than rod fishing. In the
video to the left, I cast fishing frenzy on the rod fishing spot, and I'm using a power level three oak rod. Even with
those buffs, the unbuffed net fishing spot in the video to the right outperforms the XP game. The river
between Temple Woods and Brambleweed Valley is the best early game net fishing area. Your base space is limited
early on, but you can literally stack storage chests directly on top of each other to save some room. You don't need
any special techniques to do this. Just place the chest directly on top of one another. For your first few hours of
playing Dragon Wilds, you should absolutely start in a solo world or play online only with close friends who are
also beginners. You can always use the same character from your solo world and the online worlds as you progress. You
do not need to create a new character every time you switch servers in Dragon Wilds. Always wear at least one piece of
magic armor. As you play Dragon Wilds, you will begin to notice that melee, ranged, and magic each have armor sets
that give bonuses based on how many pieces of that set you have equipped. Looking at the magic set, we can see
that by having one of the three pieces equipped, it will give us a set bonus that says negative 50% stamina regen
delay. Having stamina is the most important thing for combat, so making sure that you're equipping at least one
piece of magic armor is highly recommended. I suggest making an infinite compost farm early on in your
playthrough. Compost requires weeds, logs, or plants, which can be expensive early on. To get infinite compost, plant
around 10 to 15 redberry bushes right outside your compost bin. They can grow passively from the rain, and they won't
need replanting, and they only need you to compost them one time as you plant them. Just harvest them when they're
ripe and toss the berries into the bin. Some of the red berry plants will die from disease, but don't worry about it.
Planting 10 to 15 redberry bushes at the start of your venture will get you enough compost to last you until the
midame. At that point, you can just upgrade to super compost. Dirty water and burnt foods are edible, but they can
give you soul scourge. Soul scourge is a negative status effect that will deal 10 damage per second to your health until
the stashed effect bar fully drains. You will only receive the damage from soul scourge if you fill the bar completely.
Unused farming plots grow weeds. If you leave them uncleared for too long, they will get worse and you'll have to dig
the same plot up three times to clear it. If you destroy farming plots and rebuild them, the rebuilt plots will
spawn back with one set of weeds that needs removed. This alone can be a good way to generate weeds if you need them.
And on large farms, destroying a bunch of plots that you know have three weeds, then rebuilding them can save you a ton
of time. At level 40 artisan, you unlock the armor mannequin. You can swap your current gear set for the mannequin's
gear set with the click of one button. This is much more convenient than throwing your different gear sets into
chests and losing track of them. The gear equips directly from the mannequin. And if you have a cool gear set they
want to be displayed, the mannequins make for a great decoration. You can extract runes from events, even if your
rune crafting level is too low to craft that specific rune. The anime events do not change locations. So, if you know
you'll be needing a lot of a specific type of rune, make sure that you mark it on your map so that you can come back in
three in-game days, which is the respawn rate of events. Cook all of your single food ingredients. Once you get past the
early game and start cooking foods that require more than one ingredient, these new foods will all require the
individual ingredients to be cooked. So, as you collect berries, potatoes, and shrimp, always cook these for the early
game cooking XP and know that you will still be able to use these ingredients for foods later on. Rock Explosion is
incredible. At level 11 mining, you unlock rock explosion. Cast this spell in the middle of a cluster of rocks,
ore, or rune essence, and it will instantly harvest all the ore in its radius and give you full XP. [music] You
can do more than critical damage with a bow. At level eight range, you will learn trickshot. This is an easy skill
to miss, but when you hit a trick shot, it does 15% increased base damage before the critical damage multiplier is
applied. To perform a trick shot, you must first fully draw back a bow and fire it, even if you don't hit an enemy.
Then, on the next shot, when you fully draw back the bow, and when the arrow glows and you hear an audible indicator,
you must shoot the shot. If you're too late or too early, you will not get the 15% increased damage. You get 100% of
building materials back when you destroy objects. This means that you should never second guess whether you should
use materials to build something. If you don't like it, just tear it down. You could take advantage of this game
feature to always have a teleport back home. Just carry the items to build a load stone in your inventory. After you
teleport home and then back to the load stone, destroy that load stone that you just made and continue with your
journey. Using compost on crops increases the harvest yield by 50% and reduces disease chance by 50%. Super
compost increases yield harvest by 75% and decreases the disease chance by 75%. War bands will only attack you if you
are within range of your base. War bands are two waves of enemies and they scale up to more difficult enemies with the
difficulty of the region that your base is in. The easiest way to deal with warb bands in the early game is to find a
high object and either windstep or jump up to that location so the melee attackers cannot reach you. Then kill
the warb band with ranged or magic. The easiest way to knock down rune essence that is floating around the rune essence
fence is to use the secondary cast of your air spell. Doing so will blast a wave of air that you can use to knock
down two to three floating essence nodes in one shot. It is very difficult to AFK
and Runescape Dragon Wilds. If you need to take a break, your best bet is to log
out of the game. However, sometimes this is impossible because you are hosting a server with friends and if you log out,
they will be kicked out of the game. There is a completely safe AFK method. Start by putting a load stone in the
hidden cave east of Brambleme Valley that you visit during the restless ghost quest. And then whenever you want to
AFK, just teleport to that load stone from your primary house, and no war bands, hunting parties, or dragons will
be able to spawn there and attack you. Another tip about AFKing is that if you run out of water or food, you'll only
ever drop to one HP. You will never die in Dragon Wilds from starvation or dehydration. When attuning at a rune
alter, you can select the hard atunement before the indicator bar fully extends to the third section. [music] When you
hover over the part of the circle that is meant for hard attunements, the bar moves faster than easy and medium. So,
as soon as you know it's the right one, hit the select button. Doing this will save you a few seconds each time that
you want to attune runes. In the early game, keep at least 50 to 99 rune essence in your inventory at all
times. You will find anom events everywhere, and the vaults you enter will commonly have L rune anom events,
so keeping extra essence on you will pay off. There are two types of anom events. There are the basic anom events where
you can convert 10 pure rune essence into 100 runes. And then there are the concentrated anom events that provide
triple that output. The concentrated anom events still convert the essence at a 1 to 10 ratio. This means you will use
30 rune essence and that'll be converted into 300 runes. If you are tired of waiting for your crops to grow, then
there is another farming XP method that can get you through a few early levels. Making plant cures gives three XP each.
Plant cures require water, bones, and wheats. If you have already done some net fishing, it's possible that you
already have a couple stacks of these wheats. For the bones, at level 11 artisan, you get access to the barks to
bone spell that you can use on its cool down. If you consistently use the spell, you'll pile up a stack of bones in no
time. Additionally, the plant cures that you make play a major role in the farming skill, so they will not go to
waste. Rest to avoid debuffs. If you do not sleep, then you will notice that your maximum stamina level shortens.
When you sleep, it replenishes the rested bar at the bottom left of your screen. Stamina is important for all
skills and combat, so it is very important not to run around the game with this debuff. Adhesive is an
important material for crafting hard leather for early to midame armor, but it is hard to figure out what to do to
make it. To get adhesive, start by traveling to the whispering swamp. There you will find collectible piles of swamp
tar on the ground. [music] Gather the tar and throw it into a kiln. This turns the tar into adhesive. In addition to
crafting hard leather, you will need the adhesive to craft an important upgrade for the tannery. In addition to events
for runes early on, [music] loot packs from mobs is a great way to get runes. A tip for opening a large amount of these
loot packs is to start by splitting the stacks up. [music] Then, as you click on the stacks, just rotate between the
different stacks. As a bonus to this tip, I collected 50 goblin packs to show you exactly what to expect from these
early game mobs. To make tracking the items that I get easier, I start by storing all my items into chests. Then I
split the packs into stacks to make the looting faster. I rotate my clicks between the different stacks so that as
one pack opens, I'm already clicking on the next pack. From the 50 goblin packs, I got six wheat seeds, 94 rune essence,
and in the rune tab, I got 44 astral runes, 20 air runes, 36 law runes, 70 earth runes, 27 fire runes, 22 water
runes, and 12 nature runes. For tasks like clearing weeds from farming patches, spam clicking your action
button is actually slightly faster than holding it down. You can see in the sideby-side comparison, on the left, I
am just holding down the action button to dig weeds, but on the right, I am spam clicking. If you do like the slight
speed increase for a little more effort, then be sure to test out spam clicking with skills like wood cutting and
mining. This works in a lot of places. Enemies do have weak spots, but critical strikes and weak spots are the exact
same thing when Dragon Wilds calculates them for damage. Critical strikes and weak spot damage adds a 1.25x
multiplier. Or put simply, they increase the base damage by 25%. Arrows and runes do not drop on death. This is great
because when you die, as long as you have long runes, you can teleport back to the closest load stone to your death
location. There are three go-to experience boosting items that you should use every time you farm, fish,
and rune craft. There is food like the sweet veg bowl that gives a knowledgeable nourishment buff and
grants 10% XP boosts to all skills. The next item is jewelry. Some of the early game rings give a 5% experience boost to
specific skills. And the third item is potions like the weak focused fishing potion. You can get all three of these
XP boosting items early on in your playthrough. Together, they will add a 30% experience boost when you're
targeting specific skills. [music] Magic armor is not only beneficial during combat. For skills like fishing, where
you constantly drain your stamina down to zero, make sure that you have a piece of magic armor equipped for the one out
of three set bonus that benefits your stamina regeneration time. The spell named internal alchemy will refresh your
food buffs, but it does not refresh your potion buffs. One of the best uses for internal alchemy is while fishing since
your fishing trips will often outlast the food buff timer. When playing with friends, you can all throw your gear
into one pile and repair everybody's items with one spell. When one of your players casts magical mending on the
pile, the gear will go back to the inventory of the players who threw it on the ground. Be sure to remember this tip
the next time you go into a vault, there's bound to be a friend who doesn't have the runes to cast magical mending,
and you can be the hero. Eggs and salmon combined into one of the most powerful Midgame foods. You can catch salmon by
fishing with a pole in the fractured plains. And the eggs are easy to get. Just kill some chickens near the
starting region. Once you have the ingredients, you will need to cook the meal named eggs royal on a stone range.
Eggs royal heals a massive 120 health and gives you a passive named sea life. This passively regenerates your hit
points. This is an amazing buff to have during combat. In the video, you can see me getting hit constantly by the
enemies, but without using any other forms of healing, the sea life passive is giving me a major advantage. If you
ever feel like you're not sure what the game wants you to do next, look at your compass. The compass is the line that's
displayed at the top of your screen, and by default, you'll be tracking the main quest line. The quest line symbol will
appear on the compass. If you open up your map, you can select and track or unttrack all the quests that you have
access to. But do note that some of the quests will not show you the exact locations where to collect some of the
quest items. Runescape games and games made by this developer, Jaddex, typically include puzzles, but never be
afraid to look up the solutions if you get stuck. Agility courses exist. You can see the agility course starting
zones on your map. They have a racing flag icon. To try out an agility course, simply walk to the location on the map,
click the flag standard, and begin. You can compete for gold, silver, or bronze placement rewards which are determined
by how fast you complete the course. Additionally, you will receive a good chunk of experience for course
completions and unique rewards that you cannot get anywhere else. An easy to miss agility skill is air dash. At level
32 agility, you gain access to this ability. When you jump or double jump, press the dodge hotkey and you will dash
forward in the air. Many adventurers do not realize that they've unlocked a skill, and they will go most of their
playthrough without knowing it exists. To rod fish, you simply just cast out your lure and pull the rod in the
opposite direction of the fish. You will see the fishing bar turn bright red if the line is about to break. Do not reel
in as this happens. Only reel in when the line is blue and the fish is taking a break from pulling hard in the
opposite direction of your rod tip. At level 39 fishing, you get access to the tackle box. is a storage container that
stores up to 48 fishing baits, and it can store your rods and nets. There are different kinds of lures for each
region, and these improve your chance to catch specific fish instead of junk. When you hover over the bait, you will
see its power level. This power level can be used as an indicator to match the region that you're fishing in. Here are
a few of the early game baits and what they catch. Shrimp bait is used for sardines, feather bait to catch trout,
and anchovy bait is used for herring. Vault Guardians can be challenging, but just know that they are weak to crush
weapons such as maces and warhammers. They are one of the few Dragon Wilds creatures that have immunities. They are
immune to poison, bleed, and burning. So, although they are not resistant to fire, you will still do less damage
using fire spells because of the burn immunity. When wood cutting, after you chop down a few trees and the logs are
sitting close together, you can hit multiple logs at once with your overhead swing. Always try to hit as many logs as
you can at the same time. It will save you stamina and preserve your axe durability. This same concept applies to
mining nodes. This location on the map is next to a cave where I suggest putting in a low stone in the mid to
early game. This cave gives you access to multiple tin and copper nodes, as well as there being a river just down
the hill for net fishing. Additionally, it gets you close to the stormtouched highlands region, which contains iron,
as mentioned in an earlier tip. Anom events use 10 essence to produce 100 runes. This grants you less experience
per rune essence than atunement in a rune alter. You can see I get 50 experience for 10 rune essence used on
this earth anom event. Autocrafting is the fastest way to convert large amounts of rune essence into runes and gives you
five times your rune essence as runes. [music] In the video you can see me autocraft 50 rune essence and I received
250 earth runes, but I only gained 63 experience. That's nearly five times less experience than anima events. The
overall winner for rune crafting XP and for how many runes you get per rune essence is attunement. When you use the
rune alter, you will see the option to attune your rune essence into the desired rune type. In the first step of
attunement, you must rotate your pointer until you see the attunement ways become large enough that you can lock them in
at the high level of attunement. The second step is the infusion phase where you rotate the pointer to seal the
cracks that appear in the rune. The time that you're in this phase is dependent on your rune crafting level. There will
be a maximum of five cracks that appear at one time, and failure to seal these cracks will reduce the bonus runes that
you receive. Regardless of if you failed the infusion, you still get more experience than you would by
autocraftrafting the runes. In the video, you can see that I receive a massive 456 experience for my 50 rune
essence, compared to the 63 for 50 essence I got when I autocrafted the runes. The color of the hit splat when
you do damage to an enemy can tell you a lot of information. A plain red hit splat means you are doing normal base
damage to the enemy. A grade out red means the enemy is resistant to the damage type. A red hit splat with orange
edges means the enemy is weak to the damage type. And a hit splat that is orange in the center but red towards the
outside means that you did a critical strike. Plant your trees in a straight line. Tree seeds do not require farming
plots. And when you plant them in a straight line, you can easily harvest them with the actual projection spell.
Trees will regrow from the tree stumps, so leave those behind. Constantly make sure that you're collecting flax that
you find. Flax is one of the few basic materials they will never outlevel. Pick it up every time that you see it to
prevent massive roadblocks later on in your playthrough. Early game items use the flax for thread, but as you
progress, you will use it to make cloth. Then as you progress further than that, you will combine that cloth with other
cloth to make new cloth. It never ends, so collect it all. You can get a 100% agility experience boost while exploring
the world with just one item. Completing agility courses rewards you with an item called warped feathers. [music]
You can craft the Gearhawk amulet with eight warped feathers and five course thread. This amulet can be equipped to
your trinket slot and it gives you 100% agility experience when you're exploring the world. A huge part of Dragon Wild's
progression is permanently upgrading your health. To do this, collect the Sanguine urns found throughout the
different regions. The earns are displayed on your map, and each earn that you collect will permanently raise
your maximum health by 10. Stacking the 25% buff that you get from an enemy's weakness to a damage type, along with
the 25% buff for a critical strike actually does more than just the 50% increase in damage. The way this is
calculated is that the 25% buff to damage for the weakness is calculated as base damage and then the 25% increase
for the critical strike is applied as a 1.25 times multiplier. So together instead of just 50% you do 56.25%
more damage. If you have never heard of this before, it's because I spent two days fighting rats and goblins to
calculate the formula used. And at the time that I'm posting this video, this information is not on the internet or
available anywhere else. So far, if you're enjoying the quality of these tips, subscribe. As you build out your
farming area, keep your farming plots touching in a tight square. This allows you to efficiently use the uproot spell
that you learn at level 15 farming to harvest multiple plots simultaneously. Clean your dirty water. At the start of
the game, you will collect dirty water from rivers and ponds. Build a campfire directly next to that river or pond and
collect a few stacks of dirty water. Throw them into the campfire and it will spit out clean water that is better to
drink. This has the additional benefit of giving you early game cooking experience. Each dirty water gives you 2
XP and a stack of dirty water will give you 198 experience. The timer for food and potion buffs will countdown for
whatever the amount of time that you sleep for is. You can see that I have four buffs with a good amount of time
left on the buffs. As soon as I go to sleep, the buffs go down by the amount of in-game time that I slept through.
Sleeping can be beneficial for farming. Since Dragon Wilds treats sleeping as if time still passes by, if you have crops
that are growing, when you go to sleep, the timer will still continue to countdown for those crops and they might
get to the next stage. In the video, I have a few rows of crops that have not fully grown. When I wake up from my
sleep, I immediately go to check on them. They are now at their next stage of growth, which is fully grown. The
items from chests that you find throughout the world actually respawn. Most operate on a 5day in-game timer, so
remember where the good ones are. There are no healing potions in Dragon Wilds. If you're watching outdated content,
then you might hear about healing potions. They were removed from the game in June of 2026. Do not waste your time
trying to craft them. Use food and magic to heal. Sometimes you have to fight two
enemies at once. Or do you? At level 30 magic, you get a spell called confuse. The spell twists the minds of lesser
enemies, making it so that they cannot distinguish friend from foe. This is essentially a mind control effect, and
it is very fun, and it can be very useful in sticky situations. Rain catchers and wells that you access as
you progress will not allow you to gather clean drinking water that [music] is used in recipes. The only way to get
clean drinking water is by cooking it. As discussed in an earlier tip, the magic damage that you deal is very
predictable. By going to your journal and looking at a rune, such as an air rune, you will see that it says 13 to 22
damage. With this knowledge, we can calculate exactly how much damage our air spells with a specific staff will
do. The Blightwood staff has a 4.1 times multiplier. Most people think that this means that each cast randomly does
between 52 and 89 damage, but that's not true. Your spells will always do the low end of the damage on the first cast of
the magic casting combo. And as the [music] last cast of the magic combo, it will always select that high-end number.
You'll have seen in the video that when I do just a single cast, it does 52 damage, but it does that 89 damage
consistently as the last cast. If you plant a high tier seed and a low tier plot, it does not reduce the final yield
that you get. The effect that it has is that the plant is more likely to become diseased as it grows. Seeds that come
from the level 3 to four region of Gornfell do grow better in oak farming plots. They will get less disease and be
less likely to die. However, the seeds that you gathered from lower level regions will not grow well in the oak
plots. Make sure you're always growing your seeds in the region equivalent plots. You can burn food when cooking,
but don't throw it away. It still restores some substance just at a lower rate. You can also use some burnt foods
as ingredients for making normal combos. Other than the lakes of lightness that I will teach you about in a later tip,
it's hard to increase your carrying capacity. The good news is at level 50 and 75 agility, you will unlock the
backpacker and explorer perks that do increase your capacity. So, just keep running around and exploring and
eventually you'll get there. Keep your base organized starting early on in your playthrough. In the bottom left of the
chests menu, there's a very easy to miss name option. Type the name of the type of items that you want stored in that
chest. Then when you hover over the chest, you will see it. The chests also have an option to make the chest private
for adventurers who play with friends. And there is an option to unlink the chest, which means the items in the
chest will not automatically be used when people are crafting within the vicinity. Another small tip about chests
is that they have a sort button. This automatically organizes all the contents alphabetically. You should be placing
your farming plots and rows of five side by side. This will help because you can use the spell humidify to water all the
crops in these rows. [music] This also becomes even more important once you hit level 50 farming because you will gain
the cleansing rain ability. This spell is humidify, but it also clears out any diseases from your crops. For beginners,
it can be difficult to figure out what you need to make your first bow for ranged combat. To get started, create a
spinning wheel and then use flax that you gather from the starting zone on that spinning wheel to make coarse
thread. Combine wood and the coarse thread at a crafting table to make your first bow. Don't forget that when you
shoot the bow, you need to hold down the aim button until the bow is fully drawn for maximum damage. Similar to the last
tip, it can be hard to figure out how to start using magic combat spells. Make coarse thread in the same way as before.
